PROP-e5782b58-inv-008.text: Registration must be atomic: members.users, attendance.users, and team relations all succeed or all fail.
PROP-e5782b58-inv-008.assertion: forall completeRegistration: (members.users + attendance.users + relations) in single transaction

locations.note: Registration inserts to members (line 284-293), updates auth metadata (line 301-308), then inserts member_team_relations (line 315-317) as separate awaits — NOT wrapped in a transaction. Partial failure is possible (e.g., member inserted but team relations fail). Note: stem-system has no attendance.users table — only members and member_team_relations.
